title: Uploading inventory
summary: Upload {pos}'s daily retail items export so every report has today's stock and prices. Missing a day is fine.

items: In {pos}, export the **retail items** report (CSV or Excel).
In RetailOps, open Home (website) or Store › Stock › Upload inventory (app).
Choose the file exactly as {pos} gave it. Don't open and re-save it first.
If a delivery came today, tick **We received a delivery today** and pick the vendors.
Wait for the upload bar, then Processing. Large files take a little while.

blocks.text: Don't edit the file. Columns are matched by their exact header text, so a renamed or re-saved column can make the upload fail.
Every report always uses the most recent upload. Skip a few days and reports quietly use the last file: counts and prices are just a little older until the next one.

If an invoice was already uploaded today for a vendor, that vendor is ticked for you. Change it freely. After the upload, **Review delivery** opens a page per vendor with the items that probably arrived. See [Delivery Review](article:delivery-review).
Do I still need to upload?

Once an admin turns on [Inventory from {pos}](article:setup-inventory-from-pos), RetailOps builds each day's inventory from {pos} at 4:05 AM, so the daily upload becomes optional. Cost, vendor codes and last-received dates still only come from a file, so upload one now and then. The **Inventory upload due** alert reminds you once the last file is 7 days old.
